summary: UBS Group AG and UBS AG filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on April 29, 2026, containing presentation materials for their First Quarter 2026 Results. This is a routine periodic earnings report filed by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation corporate action. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other event-driven category is present. The filing solely provides financial results, with no terms, board recommendations, advisors, or deal mechanics. As a standard quarterly disclosure, it does not qualify as a special situation.
